title: 有馬記念の後に・世紀末の始まり

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And that's all she wrote for the Arima Kinen! Our all-star lineup today has given us a race that we won't soon forget!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: We're witnessing the Golden Generation being supplanted by this year's newcomers, led by T.M. Opera O! What a spectacular event!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! As far as opening acts for a generational clash go, I suppose this will do.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Spe and Grass… I have observed very well the footprints of your history with every step you've taken.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The time is nigh. I, the Overlord, will carry on in your stead.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: In the next year, this competition of ours will be settled once and for all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Without question—I humbly accept your challenge.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really… Opera O, you're so much stronger than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And this is just the Classics! Come next year, I can't even imagine what's gonna happen!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh. It'll be beyond your wildest dreams. I can tell you that much.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The path of an overlord is never-ending, and I'm on a journey to become the Centurial Overlord, ruler of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! Haaaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha—gahagh! Cough! Cough!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Oh no! It appears T.M. Opera O has begun to choke!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! Why is there still commentary?
The star of today's intense competition both inspires the crowd and brings them to laughter. Finally, we make our leave from the course.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: With that, my classic year has concluded. I appreciate your diligent work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But thus closes this act of the heroic tale of the young Prince T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A new one is to begin in the next year when I will be a senior.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It shall be an epic, detailing my clash with the older generation.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No longer will I seek their counsel through bouts.
choice_data_list: You never planned to ask for their help in the first place.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! Excellent point!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am the Overlord. I was born to have this role!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If I were to ask for anything, it would be the money in your wallet. Hah ha ha!
I know that was a joke, but I can't seem to laugh along.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer. In order to bring about the resplendent future in which I rule over the next generation…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What race would you consider best? Give me the name of one worthy of the Overlord.
A senior year race in spring comes to mind. In fact, the choice is obvious.
choice_data_list: How about the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho! Hark, the beautiful sound I yearned to hear—the king of all races!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It boasts notoriety and prestige! A majestic 3200-meter parade with the greatest racer at the helm!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A fitting rite of passage for this new ruler, to be sure!
It's set. Deciding on a goal for next year was a breeze.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's settled. Our march toward victory begins at next year's spring Tenno Sho!
